items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And Moray, Louis Moray, he had a dancing place. Every Sunday he had a dance.

ctx.x: Who sponsored the dances around here? They would put up the money for them. They don't.
Well, we had a community club at Notchua. It was a club they had in response to dancing. And Moray, Louis Moray, he had a dancing place. Every Sunday he had a dance.
